ampoule.name: Ampoule
ampoule.description: Increases ATK by 20% but decreases Max HP by 20%

divine_wine.name: Mysterious Divine Wine
divine_wine.description: Heals 10% of Max HP per turn

bronze_apple.name: Bronze Apple
bronze_apple.description: Heals 20% HP when taking damage if HP is below 50% (one-time use, doesn't trigger on lethal damage)

small_bell.name: Small Bell of Absolution
small_bell.description: Wake from stun/sleep once when afflicted

fruit_of_eternity.name: Fruit of Eternity
fruit_of_eternity.description: Revive with 1 HP when defeated (one-time, does not stack with existing guts)

black_grail.name: Black Grail
black_grail.description: Increases ATK by 50%, but take 5000 HP damage per turn (lasts indefinitely)

eject_button.name: Eject Button
eject_button.description: Move to the back of the line when hit while in front position (one-time, doesn't trigger on DoT)

poison_apple.name: Poison Apple
poison_apple.description: Inflicts stun on this servant upon entering battle

thanatos_blade.name: Thanatos Piercing Blade
thanatos_blade.description: Grants ability to pierce through Guts effects, preventing enemy revival (lasts 3 turns)

sealbreaker_sigil.name: Sealbreaker's Sigil
sealbreaker_sigil.description: Negates one Skill Seal effect when it would be applied (one-time use)

tsukumo_mirror.name: Tsukumo Mirror
tsukumo_mirror.description: Protects from buff removal effects once

divine_lens.name: Divine Lens
divine_lens.description: Increases Max HP by 500% for 5 turns, but lowers defense by 20% permanently
